issue_request: FHIR-6298 was a Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core change request about the old 2015May QICore AdverseEvent profile page. It reported inaccessible descriptions and bindings, including hidden AdverseEvent.cause.item reference types and bad allergyintolerance-resolutionAge extension navigation/mapping visibility.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-6298 or #6298. Historical 2015 renderer commits match the reported symptoms, especially 9d79e52769134e7c122880192808e5c09153a12a adding explicit Reference target display in generated tables, and same-family QICore rendering fixes 2b386077e4d242423c19a93a129e1982c7319b58 and 52fb8e4178eced3cf2da788c126ae1cdd4a3ce20 already documented by related audits.
additional_context: The affected QICore artifact is no longer in the current core build: source/igs.xml comments out qicore, source/fhir.ini has no active QICore profile entry, and no current guides/qicore or source/guides/qicore files exist. allergyintolerance-resolutionAge now lives in the separate FHIR Extension Pack checkout, and related FHIR-8194, FHIR-8196, and FHIR-8705 audits already exist on the combined branch.
reconciliation: No source files were changed. The correct reconciliation is an external-repo/current-build-scope audit because editing historical release artifacts, re-enabling retired QICore source, or changing the current core AdverseEvent resource would not fix a current HL7/fhir build artifact.
